Long before he arrived in the UFC and established himself as one of the lightweight division's biggest attractions, Michael Chandler had already built a reputation as a three-time Bellator champion. At 40, standing on the cusp of a fight unlike any other in MMA history, the American believes he has found something equally valuable: personal validation.
title: 'This one's for me': Michael Chandler on UFC Freedom 250, fighting at the White House

author: DHANANJAY MAHAPATRA
description: Writing the judgment, Justice N Kotiswar Singh said, “While it is important to make an assessment as to how a child will respond to either of the parents, it is equally important to ascertain mental and psychological conditions of the parents themselves to deal with the needs of the growing child.” SC said the assessment of the parents’ psychological conditions must be conducted prior to a similar assessment of the child to understand compatibility with each of the parents.
title: Psych evaluation of parents a must in child custody disputes, rules SC

author: SUMIT ROY
description: Candace Owens stirred debate after reacting to a New York Times report about a reported phone call between Donald Trump and Charlie Kirk. Laura Loomer claimed Owens accused Trump of killing Kirk, but Owens never directly made that allegation. The exchange divided social media users, with some supporting Owens’ questions and others criticizing her claims.
title: Candace Owens sparked fresh speculation as Laura Loomer pushed back quickly

author: BARSHA DUTTA
description: Neymar will miss FIFA World Cup 2026 opener between Brazil and Morocco due to a calf injury suffered in May. Brazil coach Carlo Ancelotti confirmed the forward is recovering well and could return next week. Neymar has not played for Brazil since 2023. Brazil begin their Group C campaign under pressure as they chase their first World Cup title since 2002.
title: Neymar was ruled out of Brazil’s clash with Morocco after a major injury blow

author: BHARTI JAIN
title: Bangladesh border guards raise pushback issue at BSF meet

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Ram Charan's 'Peddi' continues its strong box office run, nearing the Rs 200 crore net mark in India despite a slight dip on Day 9. The sports action drama has amassed Rs 198.70 crore net domestically and Rs 286.38 crore worldwide. Critics praise Charan's committed performance, highlighting his portrayal of a fight for identity and self-respect.
title: 'Peddi' BO day 9: Ram Charan film earns Rs 286.38 cr

author: TNN
description: While none from the rebel camp contested the screenshots, almost everyone voiced grievance against Abhishek Banerjee. Lashing out, Abhishek said, “BJP has been trying many tactics — from creating rift in our party to intimidating party workers, taking over party offices, and destroying our organisation. But no matter what they do, they cannot deny the fact that 2.6 crore people voted for us and we got a 41% votes. We will continue to fight against this oppression.”
title: Rebels claim 19 MPs in ‘real TMC’ fight, set to meet Speaker

author: TNN
description: Sources within NDA suggest one of the parties that may see desertion from its ranks is Sena UBT, a possibility being talked about since the alliance swept the assembly polls in Maharashtra but has gained traction now. The Uddhav Thackeray-led party has nine MPs in Lok Sabha and six of them will have to merge with another party — Shiv Sena led by deputy CM Eknath Shinde seen as the most probable option — to avoid losing membership under the anti-defection law.
title: NDA looks to boost numbers in Lok Sabha, Sena UBT may also split

author: MIHIR TANKSALE
description: Authorities in Bhosari are probing a troubling case involving two female IT employees and a social media contact, who are accused of contributing to the death of a 48-year-old tech professional. The investigation kicked off following a suicide note and a complaint from the victim's son highlighting the alleged harassment they faced.
title: Pune techie suicide: 3 booked, including 2 women colleagues from IT firm

author: VINEET RAMAKRISHNAN
description: Years after becoming the UFC's knockout king, Derrick Lewis finds himself with something every fighter chases - one more unforgettable stage. The heavyweight veteran, who owns a record 16 UFC knockouts, heads to UFC Freedom 250 against Josh Hokit with the White House serving as an extraordinary backdrop. Calling it his "Super Bowl" and "championship fight", Lewis hopes what people remember is "probably the best performance" of his career.
title: 'This is my Super Bowl': Derrick Lewis eyes one more defining moment at UFC Freedom 250

author: DIPAK K DASH
description: As per a UN Motorcycle Helmet Study, motorcyclists are 26 times more likely to die in road crashes than drivers of cars and wearing an appropriate helmet “improves their chances of survival by 42% and helps avoid 69% of injuries to riders.” Similarly, as per World Health Organisation, seat-belts are approximately 50% effective in preventing fatalities in crashes in which motorists would otherwise die.
title: Standard helmets & seat belts could have saved thousands of lives on roads in 2024

author: SUDEEPT MISHRA
description: An FIR has been registered against two nursing officers at AIIMS Bhopal following the death of a three-year-old child. An internal inquiry found gross negligence in handling formalin, a hazardous chemical, which was allegedly administered to the child through an IV line, leading to his death during treatment.
title: 3-year-old cancer patient dies at AIIMS Bhopal after nurse injects formalin

author: PANKUL SHARMA
description: The Uttarakhand High Court has halted the deportation of a Pakistani Sikh family residing in Dehradun on a long-term visa. The court directed the state government not to deport them unless they pose a national security risk. The family, in India since 2019, challenged a 24-hour departure notice, citing their valid visa and children's education.
title: HC tells Uttarakhand govt not to deport Pak Sikhs if they pose no threat
